messages:
maria: FYI CI started flagging ~2k SAST results with "owner: unknown" after last night's infra roll. Suspect decryption failures for archived artifacts. anyone else?

oliver: I saw the failures. CI shows KMS 403s when scanner tries to decrypt. Could be an RBAC drift.

scanner-bot: job: sast/9921 -> ERROR PermissionDenied: projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/sast-key: decrypt denied for serviceAccount:scanner-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com

jake: I rebased an IAM group change yesterday (PR #3579) to consolidate infra groups. That PR removed a nested group; maybe scanner-runner lost membership.

maria: full error from build logs:
```
ERROR: 403 PermissionDenied
Resource: projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/sast-key
Action: decrypt
Caller: serviceAccount:scanner-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Permission: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt
```

toni: This is an incident risk (missed vulns). @sec-oncall please stand up an incident channel and advise mitigations. :rotating_light:

sec-oncall: Opening #inc-318765-keystore-decrypt. Immediate mitigation: temporary grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to scanner-runner@...; re-run affected CI jobs and backfill archive decrypts. Next: root-cause analysis and guardrails.

oliver: Quick gcloud to apply temporary grant:
```bash
PROJECT=rdw-prod
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding sast-key \
  --location=global --keyring=keystore \
  --member=serviceAccount:scanner-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --project=$PROJECT
```

maria: Applied by sec-oncall. Re-running failing jobs now and queuing a full backfill to re-decrypt all artifacts. ETA 35m.

jake: Two quick follow-ups to prevent recurrence: 1) presubmit integration that verifies scanner-runner has decrypt permission, 2) an audit alert for any KMS IAM changes that remove service accounts or groups that resolve to them.

infra-logs: Audit search result: IAM policy change at ts=3187659850 performed by devops-bot@redwood-inference. Change: removed member via group resolution, which indirectly dropped scanner-runner from keystore binding. Log link: projects/rdw-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity/entries/def456. Note: current audit retention set to 30d.

sec-oncall: Root cause = automated group reorg removed scanner-runner indirectly. Action items:
- emergency RBAC restore (complete)
- runbackfill and verify new findings (maria/jake)
- add presubmit/integration check for SA->KMS decrypt (jake)
- extend auditlog retention for keystore admin events to 90d and add alert rule (infra/security)
- update SDLC runbook: require KMS access verification step for infra group PRs (toni)

maria: I'll open an incident RFC with the timeline, affected jobs, and the presubmit PR link. Also enumerating all SAs dependent on sast-key to add safety checks.

toni: Once backfill completes, we'll do a short postmortem and tag any findings discovered during the gap as "delay-validated" until owners confirm.

maria: Backfill started; watching job logs. Will post status in #inc-318765-keystore-decrypt.

scanner-bot: queued: sast backfill job #9930 started (re-decrypting archives).

sec-oncall: Closing triage notes: mark findings surfaced in the window 3187659800-3187659999 as "potentially-delayed"; owners must re-evaluate severity. RFC + runbook PR to follow. :white_check_mark:
